title: Run the evaluation on the real model and record the report
goal: A report says whether the skill beats the baseline on held-out cases, in both languages
acceptance: Owner decision 2026-11-26 in chat: "y" to the skills panel and pre-flight skill plan (earlier: "pre flight check, ok", real data).

After the owner says yes to the model run (a real-model run is the owner's call, as in F-120-T13), the agent runs the F-146-T05 runner with the profile model (for example gemma4:12b) and nerv skills evaluate, once; the report (with-skill against baseline, regression and holdout, Italian and English) is recorded in F-146 with the model and its digest; no skill is promoted by the agent

If the skill does not beat the baseline on the holdout cases in both languages, the record says so and the instructions are revised in a new version before the owner is asked; evals/gauntlet/ledger.json is not touched by a local run unless the run is a Gauntlet run the owner approved
privacy: Neutral invented skills, fleets, spots and weather only; no owner data, tokens or coordinates of a real place in Git or tests.
escalation: Any run of a real model needs the owner's yes first
A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26: one run and a short record, at the model's own speed. Not a measurement.
